newsitem.title: UK: SBC Warburg to advise on Postabank cap increase.
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg to advise on Postabank cap increase.

text.p: SBC Warburg said on Friday it had been appointed to advise Hungary's second largest retail bank Postabank on its plan to introduce an international strategic partner through a capital increase.
In a statement, SBC Warburg said Postabank's plan was part of a long standing strategy to reinforce its shareholder base.
SBC Warburg said Postabank had total assets of $2.3 billion equivalent according to unconsolidated year-end 1996 accounts, with 3.5 million customers and a nation-wide network of 3,200 outlets.
It is majority owned by Hungarian institutions and individuals.
The bank has been hit by a large wave of withdrawals recently.
A five-day run of depositors on Postabank sparked by rumours that the bank might become insolvent ended on Monday.
Hungarian officials have said they did not see any lasting ill-effect for the banking system from the run, which ended after regulators said Postabank was sound.
